name: Lizbeth Renova
office: Montebello Unified School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 2

items.text: According to her campaign, Lizbeth Renova has spent nearly 20 years in education as an educator, site supervisor and early childhood education director.

sentences.text: According to her campaign, Lizbeth Renova has spent nearly 20 years in education as an educator, site supervisor and early childhood education director.

items.text: Her campaign says she supports safe schools, strong academic programs, supported teachers and staff, and responsible leadership. In a news questionnaire, she named improving student achievement with needed support, and maintaining safe, well-supported schools, as the district's top two needs.
